summary.plain: An underground laboratory dug into a mountain in the Russian Caucasus, more than two kilometres of rock overhead, built to study neutrinos from the Sun and elsewhere.
summary.technical: Underground neutrino laboratory in the Caucasus Mountains, Russia, operated by INR RAS; the SAGE gallium detector sits about 2100 m (6900 ft) underground.
